  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 927 4212 9521

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE VIA:
  HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55116  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55117  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting
  of Thursday, September 19, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55118  Recommendation to request City Council accept Exemption CE-24-135, finding the
  proposed Zoning Code Amendment and Local Coastal Program Amendment
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act pursuant to Section
  21080.25(b)(9) of the CEQA Statute and Sections 15061(b)(3) (Common Sense

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 3, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Exemption) and 15305 (Minor Alterations in Land Use Limitations), as it will not
  result directly or indirectly in significant environmental impacts;

  Request City Council approve a Zoning Code Amendment (ZCA23-003) and Local
  Coastal Program Amendment (LCPA24-004), and adopt the proposed findings
  related thereto, to amend Chapters 21.15, 21.25, 21.27, 21.41, 21.45, and 21.52 of
  the Zoning Regulations (Title 21, Long Beach Municipal Code) related to parking
  requirements. The proposed amendments will:

  1) Eliminate requirements for additional parking to be provided for changes of use
  of buildings older than 10 years;

  2) Introduce a process and regulations for complying with California Government
  Code Section 65863.2 (elimination of parking minimums enacted by Assembly Bill
  (AB) 2097);

  3) Introduce an updated process and regulations for requests for reduction of
  parking requirements for individual nonresidential uses or projects, including but not
  limited to outdoor dining expansions established during the COVID-19 pandemic, to
  comply with Section 65907 of the California Government Code (AB 1217);

  4) Provide for compliance with California Government Code Section 65863.3
  (prohibition of additional parking requirements for expansion or alteration of a
  single-family dwelling enacted by AB 1308);

  5) Improve the code language related to parking requirements in the Zoning
  Regulations to enhance procedural consistency and accuracy in the City’s
  administration of the parking requirements, by adopting more clear and
  unambiguous code language; and

  Request City Council adopt a Resolution directing the Director of Community
  Development to submit the Local Coastal Program Amendment to the California
  Coastal Commission for approval. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
